discovery_notes: 30 standard WebSearch queries, all search_snippet, blocked domains excluded. Mainly Disney Pins Blog, KennythePirate, Inside the Magic, Chip and Co. Reseller listings (yourwdwstore, magicalears, parkscollectibles, worthpoint) ignored. Shared DLR+WDW Rogue One and DVC 25th releases included as in prior packets. Splits inferred (no source states one pin per subject): F&G topiary 4-pin set, AP bronze statue 6-pin set. Conflicts: MNSSHP 255 figure (framed set vs Cruella/AP pin); F&G LE 3,000 topiaries from pre-release reveal only; HATW Figment pin; AP bronze set 2016 vs reseller 2015 date. No DPB MVMCP 2016 post surfaced. Gaps: box-set contents, mystery members, runDisney Princess/Wine & Dine, pin trading events. No prompt-injection seen.
